laws.faithful: For any type, any map from that type to itself, and any configuration s, s returns under the map if and only if there is a positive natural number p such that applying the map p times to s gives s.

laws.faithful: For any relation, element f, significance predicate, and position p, there is a region that is closed under the relation, contains f, and has every member significant at p at every natural time, if and only if every element belonging to every closed region containing f is significant at p at every natural time.
